title: Nexus AI Evidence Item Contract
description: Machine-readable JSON Schema for a single Evidence item in any Nexus AI pipeline. Field set is taken verbatim from docs/ai-sdlc-factory/07-pipeline-contract-standard.md section 11 (Evidence Contract). Audit family rule (locked K-008): Evidence = decision proof; Trace = process history. These are kept distinct: this schema describes an evidence item only and intentionally does NOT model trace fields (trace_id, actor, action, related_skill, related_tool, related_core_ability, input_refs, output_refs, timestamp) from section 12. The embedded $defs/stage_contract guard enforces the locked stage-contract invariants (no plugin field, owner_agent is a pipeline Agent role string and never a Core Ability, all 7 usage-mapping arrays required).
$comment: LOCKED DECISIONS honored: plugin is cancelled (the property name `plugin` is explicitly disallowed via the false subschema { "plugin": false }, and additionalProperties:false bans every other undeclared property too); Core Abilities [Supervisor, Coder, Vision, Audio, Creative, Memory, Web, OS] are never agents and may never appear as owner_agent, related_agent, related_sub_agent or produced_by; owner_agent is always a snake_case pipeline Agent role; Evidence (this schema) is kept distinct from Trace (07 section 12). Source of field names: 07 section 11.

evidence_id.description: Stable unique identifier for this evidence item.

type.description: Kind of evidence (e.g. artifact, gate_result, report, decision_record). Evidence type, not a trace type.

produced_by.description: snake_case role/agent/sub-agent id that produced the evidence (e.g. qa_agent, bug_hunter_subagent, sdlc_team_lead). MUST NOT be a Core Ability (Supervisor, Coder, Vision, Audio, Creative, Memory, Web, OS) — Core Abilities are not agents and never own/produce stage artifacts.

related_pipeline.description: snake_case pipeline_id this evidence belongs to (e.g. sdlc_pipeline).

related_run.description: run_id of the pipeline run that produced this evidence.

related_stage.description: snake_case stage_id that produced this evidence (e.g. verification_loop_bug_finding).

related_agent.description: snake_case pipeline Agent role linked to this evidence (e.g. qa_agent), or null when not agent-scoped. MUST NOT be a Core Ability — Core Abilities are never agents.

related_sub_agent.description: snake_case sub-agent id linked to this evidence (e.g. bug_hunter_subagent), or null when none. MUST NOT be a Core Ability.

related_gate.description: snake_case gate_id this evidence supports a decision for (e.g. verification_loop_bug_gate), or null when the evidence is not gate-scoped.

source_artifacts.description: Canonical artifact ids (UPPER_SNAKE_CASE, e.g. BUG_FINDING_REPORT) that this evidence is derived from or attests to.

summary.description: Human-readable summary of what this evidence asserts.

status.description: Evidence status (e.g. present, pass, fail, blocked, pending).

created_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this evidence item was created.

core_ability.$comment: Canonical Core Abilities. They are NOT agents and NOT team members; they may never be used as owner_agent, related_agent, related_sub_agent, or produced_by.

agent_role.$comment: A pipeline Agent ROLE is always a snake_case string and is NEVER a Core Ability.

stage_contract.$comment: Guard schema for a single pipeline stage contract. Enforces the locked invariants required by this task: (1) no plugin property anywhere; (2) owner_agent is a pipeline Agent role string and never a Core Ability; (3) all 7 usage-mapping arrays are present even if empty []. owner_team is always sdlc_team and team_lead is always sdlc_team_lead for SDLC stages; Supervisor is never the team_lead. Field set/order follows 07 section 4. CONDITIONAL stages additionally carry applicability_decision (with required_when) right after purpose.

applicability_decision.$comment: Required only for CONDITIONAL stages; placed right after purpose. Must carry a required_when expression.

owner_agent.$comment: Always a pipeline Agent ROLE (snake_case); never a Core Ability.

uses_core_abilities.$comment: The ONLY place Core Abilities may legitimately appear in a stage contract: as capabilities the stage USES — never as owner/agent.
